After translating variables, feasibility is a standard difference-constraints system. The associated directed graph has only cycles through the auxiliary zero node, which correspond bijectively to cyclic intervals, and the one full ring cycle. The no-negative-cycle criterion is proved in the result, so the displayed barriers are simultaneously necessary and sufficient rather than merely upper bounds. The complete incenter set is the shifted H-system at the optimal radius. Zero-weight minimizing cycles force every constituent facet slack to vanish, proving the tangency statements.

value.rationale: Chainlink polytopes are a recently introduced family designed to model circular-fence and chainlink-poset rank phenomena. The theorem computes a natural realization-sensitive invariant for every member in the source's main parameter regime, not merely a symmetric example. It turns a continuous Euclidean optimization into an explicit finite minimum over cyclic intervals and simultaneously identifies forced tangent chains. The homogeneous corollary reveals a sharp qualitative transition from a unique center to a full center segment, providing structural information beyond a numerical radius.
